response.overview: The story follows a gifted racing driver who encounters an inner crisis at the peak of his career. On the track, the temptations of fame and the clutter of his mind transform into a black mist that steadily erodes his sense of self. As desire threatens to consume him entirely, he teeters on the brink of losing control. Yet, in the final moment before his sanity gives way, his original self emerges—dispelling the mist and awakening the pure passion that had nearly been extinguished. In that instant, he completes a journey of redemption and return, making a final choice between desire and true love for the sport.  At its core, the film explores how individuals in modern society can guard the purity within themselves amid the torrent of desire. On the road of ambition, have we too been clouded by the “black mist”? And do we still remember the simple, burning passion that first gave us the strength to move forward?
response.title: Noise
